rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Comprehensive developer toolkit that bundles code analysis, security auditing, web search, and persistent agent memory into a single MCP server. Includes static analysis, CVE scanning, GitHub integration, self-hosted web search via SearXNG, and cross-session memory management. Runs locally with Docker or Python, with a companion web GUI for tool management.
